// Kotlin の見本
@file:JvmName("Sample")
package com.example.sample

import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import kotlin.math.max

/** KDoc の [Point] */
data class Point(val x: Double = 0.0, var y: Double = 1.5e-3) : Comparable<Point> {
    override fun compareTo(other: Point): Int = x.compareTo(other.x)
    companion object { const val MAX = 0x1F; val ORIGIN = Point() }
}

sealed interface Shape { data class Circle(val r: Double) : Shape; object Unit : Shape }

enum class Mode(val code: Int) { FAST(1), SAFE(2); fun next() = values()[(ordinal + 1) % values().size] }

inline fun <reified T : Any> List<*>.filterType(): List<T> = filterIsInstance<T>()

suspend fun fetch(url: String, retries: Int = 3): Result<String> = coroutineScope {
    repeat(retries) { attempt ->
        try {
            return@coroutineScope Result.success(withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { "body of $url #$attempt" })
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            println("retry ${attempt + 1}: ${e.message}")
        } finally {
            delay(100L)
        }
    }
    Result.failure(IllegalStateException("gave up"))
}

fun area(s: Shape): Double = when (s) {
    is Shape.Circle -> Math.PI * s.r * s.r
    Shape.Unit -> 1.0
}

fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    val names = listOf("a", "b").map { it.uppercase() }.filter { it != "C" }
    val raw = """
        raw "string" ${names.size}
    """.trimIndent()
    var n: Int? = null
    n = n ?: max(args.size, 1_000)
    val c = '\n'
    loop@ for (i in 0 until 10 step 2) { if (i > 6) break@loop }
    println("$names $raw $n $c ${area(Shape.Circle(2.0))}")
}
val broken = "閉じない文字列
